_comment: Single source of truth for every constant used by BOTH the Python pipeline and the Svelte client. Read by pipeline/dracool/constants.py and by web/src/lib/constants.js. Section references below are to docs/DraCool.tex.

solar._comment: Section 3.3, clamping the degenerate cases. sunset_altitude_deg is the threshold at or below which the sun has set and sigma(e) = 1 for every edge by convention (Definition 1). min_altitude_deg is a_min, below which the shadow length cap applies.

shadow._comment: Section 3.3. L_max, the cap on shadow length at low sun.

sampling._comment: Section 5.2. Delta, the spacing between sample points along an edge. At 5 m the estimator error sits well under a percent for a typical block, and refining it buys precision the building heights cannot support.

heights._comment: Section 7. OSM height data is sparse, so heights resolve in order: an explicit `height` tag, then `building:levels` * storey_height_m, then the type-based default below, then default_height_m. by_building_type_m is keyed by the OSM `building` tag value. These are just my heuristics, they can be as wrong as it get.
